highlights: Revenue of $716.0 million in the third quarter of 2026 increased 8.5% from revenue of $659.9 million for the comparable prior-year period, representing a backlog conversion rate of 23.8%.
Third quarter of 2026 GAAP net income was $137.5 million, or $4.84 per diluted share, versus GAAP net income of $111.1 million, or $3.86 per diluted share, for the comparable prior-year period.
Net income margin was 19.2% and 16.8% for the third quarter of 2026 and 2025, respectively.
Revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased 8.5% to $716.0 million, compared to $659.9 million for the comparable prior-year period.
Net new business awards were $873.4 million in the third quarter of 2026, representing an increase of 10.6% from net new business awards of $789.6 million for the comparable prior-year period.

items.heading: The potential loss, delay or non-renewal of our contracts, or the non-payment by our customers for services that we have performed, could adversely affect our results.
Our backlog may not convert to net revenue at our historical conversion rates.
Our operating results have historically fluctuated between fiscal quarters and years and may continue to fluctuate in the future, which may adversely affect the market price of our stock.

Our operating margins could decrease due to increased pricing pressure or other pressures, if we are unable to either achieve efficiencies in our operating expenses or grow revenues at a rate faster than expenses.
Our customer or therapeutic area concentration may have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations or cash flows.

We bear financial risk if we underprice our fixed-fee contracts or overrun cost estimates, and our financial results can also be adversely affected by failure to receive approval for change orders or delays in documenting change orders.
